scoring_justification: Checker recomputes comparison score from agent's reported values; full DFT recompute is infeasible, but this is the strongest feasible tier for this task.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference gold values for LSDA and LSDA+U band gap and Cu magnetic moment from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table II of the paper, as stated in the conclusion text
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported values; they are the exact reproduction target.

outputs.description: Computed charge-transfer gap (eV) and local Cu magnetic moment (μB) for La2CuO4 from both LSDA (reference) and LSDA+U calculations. The checker compares against hidden paper reference values.

output_contract.notes: Only the main La2CuO4 result (gap and moment for LSDA and LSDA+U) is covered; AMF, LaCuO3, and spectral simulations are out of scope per taskability. The LSDA+U scored step is load-bearing: it requires the preceding process calculations to have been run.

steps.description: Score the LSDA (metallic nonmagnetic) and LSDA+U (insulating antiferromagnetic) results, with quantitative closeness bonus for LSDA+U.
